what: VOL.5, the move transplant: every fighter's four moves fitted onto two bodies of different rig families, by the game's own fit (src/engine/client/retarget.ts). pass: the move plays its own fighter's take on the body (stray: the worst limb's angle off the source's, degrees; pinned: how far the hips were raised or lowered to keep the feet on the floor as the source's are, in hip heights). refused: the body plays its own take for the slot, and why. own: the body's own move.
